label: anchorOffset: old content moves the opposite way to its anchor
durationKeepsSeconds: a rate change keeps the frame count, so the seconds change
replace: next.durationSeconds = p.duration ?? old.durationSeconds.map { s in old.frameRate.flatMap { o in next.frameRate.map { n in s * Double(o.numerator * n.denominator) / Double(max(1, o.denominator * n.numerator)) } } ?? s }
